candidateSources: workers and sessions referenced by current native attention items
productionCapabilityAttention.operationalRelevance: Only active or current native work contexts are eligible; idle workers are not scanned.
productionCapabilityAttention.candidateIdentity: workerId + sessionKey, falling back to workerId + taskId when no session key is known
productionCapabilityAttention.failureSemantics: A failed candidate resolver preserves native attention and reports partial/unavailable capability source completeness; it is not treated as no blocker.

openInboxRefresh.liveTransport: Existing /api/stream EventSource and Dashboard snapshot generation
openInboxRefresh.closedInbox: No Human Control refetch when closed
openInboxRefresh.openInbox: A changed snapshot generation schedules one bounded refetch while open
openInboxRefresh.pendingMutation: Refresh is deferred until the action settles, then the action path performs an authoritative read
openInboxRefresh.questionDraftPreservation: Answers are keyed by native question ID and retained for still-present questions; resolved questions are removed

runtimeLinkageAndDedup.runtimeSessionLinkage: Runtime issue/task projections propagate sessionKey when exact task/session metadata or stable task linkage provides it, while retaining taskId.
runtimeLinkageAndDedup.approvalRuntimeDedup: Same-work runtime issues are suppressed when a pending approval is the stronger item; different sessions remain visible.
runtimeLinkageAndDedup.questionRuntimeDedup: A question suppresses only the runtime item sharing the proven task/session work identity.
runtimeLinkageAndDedup.approvalBlockedDedup: A blocked capability is suppressed only for the same session and matching toolId; unrelated blocked tools remain visible.

sourceCompleteness.partialIssue: Some active capability blockers could not be verified.
sourceCompleteness.emptyInboxHonesty: Capability-source uncertainty is represented separately from an authoritative empty result.

events.cacheInvalidation: Existing event bridge and request policy
events.reconnectReconciliation: Existing bulk native inventory reconciliation; capability resolution is deferred until an Inbox read.
events.sameConnectionExecLifecycle: DOCUMENTED-RUNTIME-BEHAVIOR: the exact disposable runtime did not fan same-connection approval lifecycle events back to the certification subscriber; action reads and reconnect reconciliation remain authoritative.

performance.inboxGraph: Existing bounded Mission Control snapshot plus parallel bulk attention reads and at most 16 deduplicated capability contexts resolved with concurrency 4
performance.requestCoalescing: Existing AgentOsGatewayRequestPolicy plus one 150ms open-Inbox refresh debounce
performance.observedTiming: No additional root Dashboard capability reads; bounded detail resolution verified by deterministic instrumentation tests.
